content.comment_body: When I modify a file and try to save it, the changes are not saved. Even when using 'save as' with a different name, the progress bar shows success, but the file remains unchanged.

analysis.insight_summary: User reports that [product_name] [version_no] has a serious issue: saving or 'save as' operations do not save changes to disk, even though the progress bar implies success. This threatens data integrity and reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects that, after making edits and saving a file—either directly or with 'save as'—the changes are actually written and reflected on disk.
